title: Abstract Video Ending Classifier: drain vs fill
purpose: Reusable heuristic for quickly classifying abstract video run endings as "drain" (black frame + faint red mark) or "fill" (red-dominant frame), based on the observable outcome difference documented in art_01M64VKR0GN2KBH19JWXHJ7J4Y r2. Input is a list of closing-frame RGB means from a human reviewer or image tool; output is a structured verdict. Enables fast keep/re-run decisions without replaying the full video.
